input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: Section 2.1 expressly states that no minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies and that Customer pays only for Services ordered in an executed Order Form, with non-ordering not treated as a breach or shortfall. This is reinforced by § 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no minimum-volume commitment) and § 7.1 (no undisclosed minimum-use charge). There is no take-or-pay, committed spend, shortfall or volume-cap mechanic anywhere in the document, so the clause meets the preferred position and no fallback true-up or reduction mechanic is needed.
